title: Automation Anywhere Control Room bot runner VM offline - 45 bots unable to run
description: Bot runner VM 'BOT-RUNNER-03' went offline last night and did not come back up. 45 scheduled bots that run on this VM are all in 'Pending' state waiting for a runner. The VM is showing as powered off in the hypervisor.

worklogs.description: VM was powered off by the automated backup system due to a snapshot storage space issue. Backup agent shut down the VM to take a consistent snapshot but the post-snapshot restart failed.
Powered the VM back on. Bot runner service started automatically. Control Room shows BOT-RUNNER-03 as Active.
Rescheduled the 45 pending bots that missed their windows during the outage. High-priority bots rerun manually.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I investigated BOT-RUNNER-03. The VM was powered off by the automated backup system. The backup agent tried to take a consistent VM snapshot but ran out of snapshot storage space. When snapshot storage is full, the VMware backup agent shuts down the VM to take a crash-consistent snapshot instead of a running-VM snapshot. The post-snapshot VM restart failed silently because the restart script timed out. I am powering the VM back on now.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Please power it on. Also, which of the 45 pending bots are most critical? Some of those bots have downstream dependencies.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: VM is back online. BOT-RUNNER-03 is Active in Control Room and the bot runner service is running. Looking at the 45 pending bots - I can see the following appear to be time-sensitive based on their names and schedules: INVOICE-EXTRACT-DAILY, PAYROLL-IMPORT-AM, VENDOR-RECONCILE. Are these the critical ones, or are there others I should know about?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Yes, INVOICE-EXTRACT-DAILY is the most critical - it feeds today's invoices to AP processing. PAYROLL-IMPORT-AM is time-critical because payroll runs at noon. Can you trigger those two immediately?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Both triggered manually and running now. PAYROLL-IMPORT-AM started at 10:47, should complete well before noon. INVOICE-EXTRACT-DAILY running in parallel. The remaining 43 bots have been rescheduled within the next 2 hours. I will also work with the infrastructure team to increase snapshot storage allocation to prevent this from recurring.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Both critical bots completed successfully. The bot runner situation is resolved. Thank you for the fast response.

resolutionNote: BOT-RUNNER-03 was shut down by the VMware backup agent due to snapshot storage exhaustion. Post-snapshot restart failed silently. Powered VM back on, rescheduled 45 pending bots, manually ran 2 critical bots. Infrastructure team alerted about snapshot storage capacity.

csat.comment: VM back online and critical bots running within 45 minutes of the ticket being opened.
